meta.title: DAON — Korean Restaurant
meta.description: DAON is a Korean restaurant serving handmade ramen, Korean BBQ, hot pots and kimbap. Browse the menu and reserve your table.
meta.reservationTitle: Book a Table — DAON Korean Restaurant

hero.lead: Charcoal, broth and fermentation — the three things a Korean kitchen is built on. We cook the way a family cooks at home, and we set the table the same way: everything at once, shared, still steaming.

about.title: A meal made with care
about.body: Daon is a Korean restaurant that blends authentic flavors with a modern touch, bringing the taste and culture of Korea to your table. Using fresh ingredients and heartfelt cooking, we offer a memorable dining experience for both locals and visitors.
about.note: Every dish on this site is taken from our printed menu — same names, same prices.
about.quote: We prepare every dish using only the finest quality and the freshest ingredients, carefully selected to ensure the best taste and authentic experience.

signature.title: What people order
signature.subtitle: A few plates that leave the kitchen most often.

categories.title: Thirteen chapters
categories.subtitle: From summer noodles to hot pots for four.

cta.title: Reserve a table
cta.body: Pick a date, a time and the table you want to sit at. It takes under a minute.

menu.title: Our menu
menu.subtitle: Prices in PLN. Tap a dish for the full description.

reservation.title: Book a table
reservation.subtitle: Date, time, guests, table. Four steps, nothing more.

date.title: When would you like to come?

time.title: Pick a time
time.subtitle: Tables are held for 15 minutes after the booked time.

guests.title: How many of you?
